# The playbook

<!-- generated by tools/playbook_build.py from playbook/rules and playbook/formats: do not edit by hand -->

Every learning the pack has made, as an atomic, graded rule, and the formats that bundle them. A film starts from `mp brief` or `mp plan <format>`,
which write the learnings in as defaults, and ends with `mp lint`, which shows which learnings it kept and which it broke.

```bash
mp formats                                  # the formats, one line each
mp brief "one-line idea" --goal launch     # pick the format, write research-pack.md, then the plan
mp plan launch-film --length 35 --aspect 16:9   # a plan.json skeleton with the defaults and TODOs
mp lint plan.json                           # or a render: mp lint renders/<file>.mp4
mp rules --gaps                             # prose-only rules: the backlog
```

**Grades:** measured-A (measured on tier A/A- references), measured (any tier), craft (seen, not tied to reach), house (a pack rule), inferred (a reading, never a fact).
A failed house or measured-A rule is a FAIL in `mp lint`, measured and craft a WARN, inferred is information only.

**Status:** enforced (a check), default (`mp plan` writes it in), part (a pack id implements it), prose-only (a known gap).

**0 rules** (0 enforced, 0 default, 0 part, 0 prose-only; 0 measured-A, 0 measured, 0 craft, 0 house, 0 inferred) and **0 formats**.

Schemas: `playbook/schema/rule.schema.json`, `playbook/schema/format.schema.json`. Checks: `python3 tools/playbook_lint.py --list`. Plan defaults: `node tools/playbook_plan.mjs --defaults`.
